name: Smart Site Reviews
author: Plugincy

sections.description:
Smart Site Reviews is a top-tier plugin for showcasing your WooCommerce product reviews. It offers a variety of display options, allowing you to customize the review section through the module design settings.
With its intuitive Shortcode Generator backend, you can effortlessly create a modern and dynamic review section—an essential feature for any professional website or online store.

Why Smart Site Reviews?
Smart Site Reviews enhances your product pages by showcasing customer reviews, making your products more appealing. It also gives your site a more professional, clean, and polished look, leaving a strong impression on potential customers.
Highlighting specific reviews with Smart Site Reviews is a powerful way to build trust. When placed strategically, these reviews can help boost sales and increase conversions in your shop.

😍 KEY FEATURES

  • Responsive & Mobile-Friendly: Ensures seamless display across all devices.
  • Beautiful, Lightweight & Powerful: Enhances your site’s aesthetics without compromising performance.
  • Shortcode Generator: Easily generate and use shortcodes.
  • 2 Pre-Designed Layouts: Choose from multiple ready-to-use designs.
  • Manual Review Addition: Add one review manually.
  • Filter 5-Star Reviews: Display only top-rated reviews.
  • Hover Pause Feature: Stops the slider on hover.
  • Set Maximum Reviews: Limit the number of displayed reviews.
  • Customizable Review Display: Show/hide reviewer name, image, and review date.
  • Typography & Color Control: Customize text font size, color, and hover effects.
  • Adjust Rating Stars: Modify star ratings.
  • Customizable Review Title: Enable/disable the review title.
  • Unlimited Styling Options: Use color pickers for full customization.
  • Adaptive Review Columns: Control column display across different devices.
  • Review Sorting Options: Sort and order reviews as needed.
  • Custom Background & Reviewer Image Settings: Set background colors and adjust image dimensions.
  • User-Friendly Admin Panel: Intuitive UI for effortless customization.
  • Unique Settings Per Slider: Customize each slider independently.
  • Fully Compatible: Works with any theme and WooCommerce plugins.
  • Cross-Browser Support: Compatible with Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and more.
  • And Much More! Packed with additional customization options.

🔥 PRO Features

Unlock even more powerful features with Smart Site Reviews Pro! Learn more and see demos at: https://plugincy.com/smart-site-reviews/

  • Dark Mode Option: Switch to a sleek dark theme.
  • Social Media Review Active option with 3 Pre-Designed Layouts.
  • 3 more Pre-Designed Layouts: Choose from multiple ready-to-use designs.
  • Manual Review Addition: Add unlimited reviews manually as needed.
  • Autoplay Control: Enable/disable autoplay and adjust speed.
  • Infinite Loop: Keeps the review slider running continuously.
  • Navigation Colors: Modify Arrows, and pagination dots.
  • Show/Hide Navigation & Pagination: Full control over navigation elements.
  • Slider Pagination Speed Control: Adjust transition speeds for a smooth experience.
  • Image Preloader Option: Enable/disable image loading effects.
  • Customizable Navigation Arrows: Select styles and adjust height/width.
  • Touch & Mouse Controls: Enable/disable touch swipe and mouse drag features.

Support

For help, bug reports, or feature requests, please visit our official support page: https://plugincy.com/support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-site-reviews folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Alternatively, install the plugin through the WordPress ‘Plugins’ screen directly (Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin).
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to Smart Site Reviews in the WordPress admin area to configure the plugin settings or create new review displays using the Shortcode Generator.
sections.faq:
Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, Smart Site Reviews is designed to work seamlessly with any standard WordPress theme.

What If I uninstall the Smart Site Reviews plugin?

If you uninstall the Smart Site Reviews plugin, all of your WooCommerce product reviews data will remain fully safe in your database. However, the review sections created by Smart Site Reviews will no longer be displayed on your site.

Can I add manual reviews?

Yes, Smart Site Reviews allows you to add manual reviews, including reviewer details, content, timing, and design, through the “Manual Reviews” option in the free version (one review) and unlimited manual reviews in the Pro version.

Can I hide specific reviews on my website?

Yes, you can. Smart Site Reviews allows you to filter and select reviews, potentially by ID or other criteria, depending on the specific display module you are using.

How can I create Smart Site Reviews displays?

  1. Navigate to Smart Site Reviews > Add New (or a similar menu item for creating new review displays) in your WordPress admin area to access the Shortcode Generator Settings panel.
  2. Customize the review display using the available options and generator fields.
  3. Publish or save your configuration. A shortcode will be generated.
  4. Copy this shortcode and paste it into any page, post, or widget area where you want the reviews to appear.

How can I get support or suggest improvements?

For support queries or to suggest improvements, please visit our support page: https://plugincy.com/support. We also appreciate 5-star ratings on WordPress.org if you find the plugin helpful!
